title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 6:19-24
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 6:19-24</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="19" /> Don’t <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise" word-lang="greek" word-original="θησαυρίζετε">store up  </char> for yourselves <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise" word-lang="greek" word-original="θησαυροὺς">stored-wealth  </char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">on the land</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">where</char> moth and nibbler can ruin, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
          and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">where</char> thieves break in and steal. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="20" /> But <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise" word-lang="greek" word-original="θησαυρίζετε">store up  </char> for yourselves <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise" word-lang="greek" word-original="θησαυροὺς">stored-wealth  </char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">in the sky</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">where</char> neither moth nor nibbler can ruin, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
          and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">where</char> thieves do not break in or steal; 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="d">
          <verse number="21" /> for <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">where</char> your <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">stored-wealth</char> is, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3">
          there your heart will be also. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="22" /> The <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">lamp</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the body</char> is <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">the eye</char>; 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">so then</char> if <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">your eye</char> is genuine-and-generous, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          your <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">whole body</char> will be <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">radiant</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="23" /> But if <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">your eye</char> is bad-and-greedy, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">your whole body</char> will be <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">dark</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">If then</char> the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">light</char> that is in you is <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">darkness</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          how great is the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">darkness</char>! 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="24" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">No one is able to serve</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">two masters</char>; 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          for either he will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">hate the one</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          and <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">love the other</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          or he will be <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">devoted to one</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">despise the other</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">You are not able to serve</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">God and</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">wealth</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
